summary: Ecolab Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a proposed offering of senior unsecured notes (floating rate and fixed rate tranches). The offering's net proceeds will partly fund the pending acquisition of CoolIT Systems under a March 20, 2026 merger agreement. The notes are standard investment-grade debt securities; the filing is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5). The acquisition is mentioned solely in the use-of-proceeds context and the special mandatory redemption trigger. No special-situation event is being filed—this is a routine debt issuance.
